'''Habassa II''', also known as '''Habassa''',<ref name="XWCCD" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Habassa system/Legends|Habassa system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was the [[Habassa]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

==History==
The Habassa were enslaved by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
